en: Black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a small procession of men carrying large flags on a cobblestone street beside an iron fence and a park. One prominent flag bears a dark Nordic cross design. In the park stands a bust of a person on a pedestal with wreaths or floral tributes laid at its base. Townhouses and trees are visible in the background. A caption strip at the bottom center reads "2 oktober 1910", and a small archival mark in the lower left reads "Vk:2000:75".
